model.description: Tower Three presents Moonbutter, a premium 1G pre-roll crafted for cannabis enthusiasts seeking quality and convenience. This expertly rolled preroll delivers a smooth, flavorful smoking experience from first light to final draw. Moonbutter's rich, creamy profile blends buttery smoothness with subtle earthy undertones, creating a luxurious flavor that lingers on the palate. Perfect for both seasoned consumers and those exploring the preroll category, this single-unit offering provides a hassle-free way to enjoy premium flower without the need for grinding or rolling. Tower Three's commitment to quality ensures consistent potency and burn throughout your session. Whether unwinding after a long day or sharing with friends, Moonbutter delivers a satisfying experience that showcases the brand's dedication to excellence. Each 1G pre-roll is carefully packaged to preserve freshness and potency, making it an ideal choice for on-the-go enjoyment or relaxed home sessions.
